widgets_values:
Create a 12-second cinematic sequence.

Global continuity:
Kana is a young East Asian woman with a petite, slender frame, long glossy dark brown hair with dense straight bangs and thin side bangs, and a thick side braid resting on one shoulder secured with a small beige-gold band. Her facial identity, body proportions, and hairstyle match reference_image_urls[2] and persist identically across every shot. Her soft oval face features large dark brown eyes, a natural slight smile, and a curious, playful expression. She wears a school-uniform-inspired outfit matching reference_image_urls[3]: a white collared button-up shirt, a dark navy V-neck knit cardigan with black buttons, a black-charcoal tartan pleated mini skirt, and dark navy mid-calf socks. Her structured black leather shoulder tote bag rests on the sofa. Her character voice and vocal tone match reference_audio_urls[0]. A golden retriever puppy is present throughout, with a cream-gold coat and loose skin. The environment is a warm, sunlit living room with a beige sofa, a mustard-yellow accent cushion on the right, sheer white curtains and soft window light behind the sofa, a light wood coffee table, and a textured rug. Visual style is live-action with soft warm afternoon natural light, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, beige-cream-wood-mustard color palette, and 9:16 vertical composition. The motion direction flows consistently from left to right during the chase. It is the authoritative sample voice for Kana; preserve Kana's voice identity, vocal tone, accent, pitch, and delivery for every supplied line of dialogue.

Shot 1 — 0s to 3s:
Open on the exact composition of reference_image_urls[0]: a medium-wide, slightly high eye-level frontal view of the beige sofa, 35mm. Kana sits center on the sofa with her legs tucked, looking down at her phone. Her black tote bag rests on her left, the mustard-yellow cushion on her right, and soft window light filters through the white sheer curtains behind her. In the right foreground, a golden retriever puppy energetically tugs and shakes a white charging cable in its mouth. As the cable pulls taut, Kana feels the tension, her eyes widening in surprise as she snaps her head toward the puppy. With a shocked expression, she speaks Japanese in her reference_audio_urls[0] voice: 「あっ！それ私の充電器！」 The camera holds almost static, with only a very slow push-in synchronized to her reaction and line delivery.

Shot 2 — 3s to 6.5s:
Cut to an eye-level medium shot, 50mm, shallow depth of field, with Kana’s upper body and the puppy’s head in the same frame. Kana sets her phone down on the sofa beside her, leans forward, and raises her index finger with a firm expression as she scolds the puppy. The puppy drops the cable, flattens its ears, and obediently sits. Kana’s expression shifts from stern to proud as she nods and speaks again in her reference_audio_urls[0] voice: 「ダメ！これはオモチャじゃないの！」 Pausing, her face softens, and she adds with satisfaction: 「…よし、いい子。」 On the final beat, she starts to glance away, and the shot cuts precisely at that moment.

Shot 3 — 6.5s to 8.5s:
Cut back to a medium-wide frontal angle of the sofa, matching the framing and 35mm eye-level perspective of Shot 1. Kana relaxes, relieved, and picks up her phone again. In that instant of distraction, the puppy lunges forward and bites the toe of Kana’s navy sock on her dangling foot. The puppy pulls backward vigorously, tugging the sock completely off her foot in one swift motion, then bolts toward the right side of the frame. Kana startles and leaps up from the sofa, shouting with baffled energy in her reference_audio_urls[0] voice: 「えっ、ちょっと！？」 The action cuts on her rising motion.

Shot 4 — 8.5s to 12s:
Match-action cut to a chest-high wide tracking shot, 28mm, moving from left to right to follow the chase. The puppy sprints excitedly across the rug toward the right, the navy sock fluttering wildly from its mouth as it playfully circles the light wood coffee table and changes direction. Kana, wearing only one sock now, runs after the puppy with a laughing expression, her braid swinging, one hand outstretched as she tries to catch it. Speaking in her reference_audio_urls[0] voice with a playful, breathless tone she calls out: 「待って！私の靴下返して〜！」 The golden late-afternoon light deepens, transitioning toward a warmer sunset hue. The shot concludes precisely at the 12-second mark on the composition of reference_image_urls[1]: the puppy’s tail and the sock exit the right edge of the frame, with Kana chasing close behind, her laughing face visibly just behind it.

Audio:
Continuous warm interior room tone with faint, soft ambient air and subtle rustle of fabric. Dialogue throughout in Japanese using Kana’s exact supplied voice and vocal tone from reference_audio_urls[0], delivered with clear, distinct enunciation. Shot transitions occur with seamless acoustic continuity, carrying Kana’s vocal reactions and the light pitter-patter of the puppy’s paws across cuts. The music is minimal, with a playful light percussive beat rising gently during the chase in Shot 4, complementing the escalating golden-hour lighting.

Reference keyframe guidance (Anim-managed):
Image 1: authoritative start frame (KF1 at 0.0s). Open the video exactly on this composition, framing, and lighting.
Image 2: keyframe KF2 at 12.0s. Reach this composition at that moment.
Keyframe images show the planned timeline only; ordinary reference images after them keep their character, location, prop, and style roles.
